video_title: Steph Revives the Warriors | Are the 76ers Built to Win It All?

quotes.summary_phrase: Jontae Porter's lifetime ban for sports betting
quotes.excerpt: his lifetime ban from the NBA for gambling on the sport
quotes.quote: We're going to get into a New Yorker piece that just dropped about the Jontae Porter case, FBI probe, his lifetime ban from the NBA for gambling on the sport, the circumstances that led to it. We didn't know the details of the sting, we didn't know the details of Jontae Porter's life leading up to the arrest and the disgrace of his name and his legacy.

quotes.speaker: Wosny Lambre
quotes.summary_phrase: Philadelphia 76ers' historic 11-2 start
quotes.excerpt: Philadelphia 76ers, off to the best start in the history of the franchise at 11 and 2
quotes.quote: We also wanted to get into the Philadelphia 76ers, off to the best start in the history of the franchise at 11 and 2. A lot of on-the-ground reporting from the fan side anyway, and 76ers fans cannot be more over the moon about what's happening with this team right now.

quotes.speaker: Wosny Lambre
quotes.summary_phrase: Golden State Warriors' seven-game winning streak
quotes.excerpt: Golden State Warriors have turned this thing around, seven straight wins after an 0 and 3 start
quotes.quote: The Golden State Warriors have turned this thing around, seven straight wins after an 0 and 3 start. Steph in that stretch is averaging 33.8 points a game on splits of 52, 49, and 98 in six games. He's shooting 98% from the line. Saturday night OT masterpiece against the Magic is the capper on the streak so far.

quotes.speaker: Sean Little
quotes.summary_phrase: Brandin Podziemski's role and impact on the Warriors
quotes.excerpt: Brandin Podziemski is playing the most minutes on the team by quite a few. He takes ball-handling responsibility
quotes.quote: People all brand Brandin Podziemski a little bit of an apology if I'm being completely honest. He's playing the most minutes on the team by quite a few. He takes ball-handling responsibility off of Steph. Steph purely has been able to get to do what he does best and run around and get off ball and look for shots. Draymond deserves his creation respect, even though a lot of his other game is falling off a bit. The creation and the willingness is still there to set the table for others.

quotes.speaker: Sean Little
quotes.summary_phrase: Jonathan Kuminga's offensive development
quotes.excerpt: Jonathan Kuminga, offensively are just dynamic. I think I'm ready to call Jonathan Kuminga dynamic already offensively
quotes.quote: Jonathan Kuminga, offensively are just dynamic. I think I'm ready to call Jonathan Kuminga dynamic already offensively. He's been shooting it from deep, he's been getting to the line, the mid-range is there, the chirping is there. Everything about his game I really like on the NBA level.

quotes.speaker: Wosny Lambre
quotes.summary_phrase: Warriors' roster construction and lack of supporting cast
quotes.excerpt: Steph could be doing all of this, but it wouldn't matter if he didn't have the stuff around
quotes.quote: Steph could be doing all of this, but it wouldn't matter if he didn't have the stuff around it in terms of personnel that could get the Warriors up to a league-average level at 14th in defense. Jordan Poole ended up not working out as the other guy that would help Steph with the scoring burden. Obviously, Draymond was never going to be the case. Kuminga was kind of miscast as a number two. I think there's been times where Kuminga thought he had the pedigree and the physical gifts that would be the guy that took this on. And I think Jimmy Butler in his best, when he's been healthy, has been a great alternative to Steph just having to do every single thing.

quotes.speaker: Wosny Lambre
quotes.summary_phrase: Jonathan Kuminga's potential to pair with Steph Curry
quotes.excerpt: the emergence of Jonathan Kuminga. And the craziest thing too that a buddy of mine was telling me
quotes.quote: The thing we've seen in this streak is the emergence of Jonathan Kuminga. And the craziest thing too that a buddy of mine was telling me is like, he's not even playing his best with Steph on the court right now. Because Steph does take some getting used to in terms of what spots to be at, the sort of cut and replace and the constant moving nature of the offense, the intuitiveness it takes to play within it. But Kuminga is such a high IQ player, I really have no doubt that he's going to develop that Steph Curry mind-meld at some point in the season.

quotes.speaker: Wosny Lambre
quotes.summary_phrase: Warriors' salary cap issues and big man rotation
quotes.excerpt: Kristaps Porzingis ends up taking early or maybe a temporary retirement where he's just like, look
quotes.quote: Kristaps Porzingis ends up taking early or maybe a temporary retirement where he's just like, look, I don't even want to show up to get my 20 million that's owed to me. He's just straight up walking away from 20 million dollars, which is crazy because he was supposed to be obviously a big part of their big man depth that they paid the guy 20 million bucks to play this season. And they're trying to work something out for a team that's looking for some level of cap relief, who wants to send back a quality rotation level big.

quotes.speaker: Sean Little
quotes.summary_phrase: Al Horford's declining impact on the Celtics
quotes.excerpt: Al Horford hasn't been the guy that I think they thought would impact when they signed him
quotes.quote: Al Horford hasn't been the guy that I think they thought would impact when they signed him. He just hasn't been there. It just looks like maybe Father Time has caught up to the to the big dog Al Horford.

quotes.quote: Austin Reaves dropped 40 on these cats. An amazing team performance all around. Walker Kessler had some amazing plays down the stretch at the rim, blocking guys. Just a good, good team win.

quotes.speaker: Sean Little
quotes.summary_phrase: Walker Kessler's impact on the Lakers
quotes.excerpt: Walker Kessler, I think he's been a revelation for the Lakers. He draws so much attention
quotes.quote: Walker Kessler, I think he's been a revelation for the Lakers. He draws so much attention at the rim. You need two guys damn near blocking him out when it comes to cleaning up the glass. And offensively, you got a guy like Luka and Austin that can do what they do on a 1v1, that it almost becomes impossible to guard the corners. And the Lakers have been absolutely burning the net down on corner threes.

quotes.speaker: Sean Little
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Doncic's historic scoring production
quotes.excerpt: This is the most production we've ever seen to start the NBA season outside of Wilt Chamberlain
quotes.quote: This is the most production we've ever seen to start the NBA season outside of Wilt Chamberlain in 63. Nobody's scoring 40 points a game to start the year. Jordan in 86-87 was at like 38 points a game. Nobody since the Wilt, and you can say that about a lot of numbers, put up the offensive production that Luka has to start this year.

quotes.summary_phrase: The impact of sports betting on NBA integrity
quotes.excerpt: the role that capitalism and profit maximization plays in ensuring integrity, because we can keep it a
quotes.quote: The role that capitalism and profit maximization plays in ensuring integrity, because we can keep it a bean. It's not like DK and FanDuel are doing this out of the goodness of their heart. These are American corporations. They want to make money. And being defrauded by dudes that are cheating the game, like that's that's detriment to the bottom line. And like the role that capitalism will play in catching frauds is so it's driving so many conflicts within me and my little, you know, the little Karl Marx within me is just like, wow, that's such a a hilarious paradox right there.

quotes.speaker: Sean Little
quotes.summary_phrase: NBA's commitment to sports betting integrity
quotes.excerpt: integrity's number one and Silver knew that when he took the the the sports gambling dollars
quotes.quote: Integrity's number one and Silver knew that when he took the the the sports gambling dollars and and let them become a part of the league as a sponsor, right? So integrity's number one and that's the number one thing they have to focus on and I think they've been doing a pretty good job overall. Like you mentioned, they did catch these guys. This thing was brought up, those guys were removed from the league while stuff was under investigation like Beasley, of course. So yeah, it's being flagged, it's being caught, but it's something that will will be around and will be a part of it. But yeah, integrity's number one across the board because um we have to know what we're watching is actually the real deal and and not being compromised.
